steps.name: Clear confirmation skips
steps.do: From the project root, run `npm run clear:itinerary-config`, then reload **Itinerary**.
steps.expect: Command reports no **Don't show this again** skips (or clears any that were on). Short Visit / Early Admission confirmations are no longer skipped.

steps.name: Date-step times
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Use **Build Itinerary** / **Edit Itinerary**. On **Set Visit Date**, confirm **Arrival time** and **Departure time** are present.
steps.expect: The date step shows **Arrival time** and **Departure time** with the same labels as Day Planner.

steps.name: Next does not prompt
steps.do: Set arrival **10:00 AM** and departure **11:00 AM**, then click **Next**.
steps.expect: The next wizard step appears. **Short Visit?**, **Early Admission Hours**, and **Scheduled Items Outside Visit Hours** do not appear.

steps.name: Cancel Finish short visit
steps.expect: The builder stays open. The itinerary is not saved with those times.

steps.name: Confirm Finish short visit
steps.do: Click **Finish** again, then confirm **Short Visit?** (leave **Don't show this again** unchecked).
steps.expect: The itinerary saves. Day Planner shows arrival **10:00 AM** and departure **11:00 AM**.

steps.name: Invalid order
steps.do: On Day Planner, set **Arrival time** to **12:00 PM** while departure is **11:00 AM**.
steps.expect: Validation bubble: **Arrival time must be before departure.** Times stay **10:00 AM** / **11:00 AM**.

steps.name: Longer visit
steps.do: On Day Planner, set arrival **10:00 AM** and departure **2:00 PM**.
steps.expect: Times are kept. **Short Visit?** does not appear.

steps.name: Early admission date
steps.do: Via **Edit Itinerary** / **Set Visit Date**, pick a **today-or-future** visit date whose Day Planner shows **Early Admission** before **Zoo Opens** (seed weekends/holidays: Early Admission **9:00 AM**, Zoo Opens **9:30 AM**, through Labor Day). If no such date is selectable, mark **Blocked**.
steps.expect: **Early Admission** appears on the timeline before **Zoo Opens** — or suite **Blocked** if early-admission season has ended.

steps.name: Arrival during early admission
steps.do: If not Blocked: on Day Planner, set **Arrival time** to **9:00 AM** (before Zoo Opens). Keep departure at least **2 hours** later so **Short Visit?** does not appear.
steps.expect: **Early Admission Hours** confirmation appears (members/sensory message, with **Don't show this again**).

steps.name: Cancel early admission
steps.do: If not Blocked: click **Cancel** on that confirmation.
steps.expect: Arrival is not saved; the field returns to the previous time.

steps.name: Confirm early admission
steps.do: If not Blocked: set **Arrival time** to **9:00 AM** again and click **Confirm**.

steps.name: Arrival after open
steps.do: If not Blocked: set **Arrival time** to **10:00 AM** (at or after **Zoo Opens**).
steps.expect: Arrival is kept. **Early Admission Hours** does not appear.
